body.displayDescription: Tier 70 longbow with Darkfang (ranged basic becomes two 45-55% hits) and native Descent of Darkness special.
body.mechanicalImplementation: Darkfang rewrites the ranged basic attack in prepare when equipmentIds include item:dark-bow. Descent of Darkness is the native weapon special (specialAttackId descent_of_darkness): 65% adrenaline, two hits of 190-230% ability damage each (wiki average 420% total), 0s cooldown. With dragon arrows equipped the live name is Descent of Dragons (animation only; same bands).
body.name: Dark bow

reason: Wire Dark bow Descent of Darkness special and document Darkfang + arrow capability.
